action.command: cd /workspace/project && grep -oE '/api/[a-zA-Z0-9/_\-]{2,40}' /tmp/nmapp.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -25; echo "=== coba models endpoint nomask ==="; for p in /v1/models /api/v1/models /api/models; do printf "%-18s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 20 "https://nomask.ai$p" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(head -4 nm_api_keys.txt | tail -1 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')" -o /tmp/n.json -w "%{http_code} "; head -c 80 /tmp/n.json | tr -d '\n'; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && grep -oE '/api/[a-zA-Z0-9/_\\-]{2,40}' /tmp/nmapp.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -25; echo \"=== coba models endpoint nomask ===\"; for p in /v1/models /api/v1/models /api/models; do printf \"%-18s \" \"$p\"; curl -s --max-time 20 \"https://nomask.ai$p\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $(head -4 nm_api_keys.txt | tail -1 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,\"\",$2);print $2}')\" -o /tmp/n.json -w \"%{http_code} \"; head -c 80 /tmp/n.json | tr -d '\\n'; echo; done", "summary": "Probe nomask API endpoints", "security_risk": "LOW"}
